use: Rapid heating to high temperature and pressure in a sealed vial.
simulation: Heats by the temperature program, pressure from vapor pressure; overpressure triggers an emergency stop.
notes: Reference model profile: single-mode microwave synthesis reactor (sealed vial)
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false). Absorption efficiency, heat loss and cooling rate are model assumptions.
sources: Anton Paar Monowave 400 product literature (to be archived and checked)
to_calibrate: IR temperature vs in-vial fibre-optic temperature (IR reads the outer wall; offset can be several °C)

comms.protocol: Instrument software / LIMS export (to be confirmed)

set_temperature.description: Set hold temperature (sealed vial, may exceed atmospheric boiling point; refused if predicted pressure exceeds 85% of the limit)

set_hold.description: Set hold time (timer starts once the set temperature is reached)

start.description: Seal and run the program (heat → hold → cool to 55 °C and unlock); fill volume 2 mL to 2/3 of vial volume

stop.description: End the hold early and start cooling
